o1: Enables insulin receptor activity; PTB domain binding activity; SH2 domain binding activity; and protein kinase binding activity. Involved in dauer exit; determination of adult lifespan; regulation of gene expression; and the innate immune response. Acts upstream of or within embryonic body morphogenesis and acts upstream of with a negative effect on protein import into nucleus. Is located in the axon; neuronal cell body; and non-motile cilium. Is expressed in coelomocyte; germ line; gonad; nervous system; and vulva. Is part of the insulin-like signaling pathway; insulin receptor signaling pathway; and let-502/mel-11 pathway. Used to study Parkinson’s disease; diabetes mellitus; and Pseudomonas aeruginosa infection. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in dementia (multiple); glucose metabolism disease (multiple); kidney cancer (multiple); liver disease (multiple); and reproductive organ cancer (multiple). Orthologous to human IGF1R (insulin like growth factor 1 receptor); INSR (insulin receptor); and INSRR (insulin receptor related receptor). DAF-2 ameliorates the hypersusceptibility to pathogens phenotype.
